claim: A fresh boot of the same diagnostic image separates accumulated runtime state from persistent initialization failure.
oracle: New boot_id, same kernel and diagnostic gate, no FTS/autoloaded PMIC regulator drivers; minimal identity test either stable3648 or recordedfailure; USB serial verifies new SSH host key before reconnect.

validation.user_journey: Phone briefly restarts and returns to diagnostic Linux without user keys; if USB cannot reconnect, use existing serial and Fastboot recovery path, do not blind-flash.
code_reasoning: Verified live /init waits for /run/oriole-stage-continue before switch_root
Only normal reboot; no slot or image mutation
Sync userdata; save pre-reboot private logs and fingerprints
No automatic host-key acceptance: obtain public key via direct USB serial then pin
Custom shell PID1 does not handle normal init reboot request; sync and unmount /newroot then busybox reboot -f invokes syscall. Abort if unmount fails.
validation.unit: No new boot implementation; validate plan fields and reuse existing serial/discovery tools; hardware reconnect cannot be unit-proven.
validation.end_to_end: Save boot_id, reboot once, poll USB <=60s, retrieve host key throughserial, SSH challenge, reload only required mailbox/ACPM and known diagnostic modules; collect newboot identity and rollback. Mac4 lock blocks NCM registration; fallback transports hash-verified modules over USB ACM serial to RAM. Use serial host log and same hardware watchdog; cleanup trap restores rails and modprobe before disarming. USB network acceptance remains pending.

evidence: Plain busybox reboot returned0 but serial showed unchangedboot_id and uptime: no reboot occurred.
limitations: Normal reboot is not a physical battery power cycle; some hardware state can persist
May require human physical recovery if neitherUSBnorFastbootresponds
exit_gate: Fresh boot independently verified and storage protection checked before any module test; failed reconnect stops hardware experiments.

result.boot: Differentboot_id, uptime7seconds, initiallynomodules, diagnosticgateheld; USBserialhostkey verified

network_recovery: After user unlocked Mac4, boundedUSB gadget UDC unbind/rebind restoredNCM/en8. NewinitramfshostkeyverifiedthroughphysicalUSBserial beforeSSHpinupdate.
